risks: Accessibility of drag and resize. Pointer-only dragging fails WCAG 2.5.7 (dragging movements) and 2.1.1 (keyboard). Provide the keyboard Move mode, a 'Move to…' menu and the S/M/L/XL resize picker; announce changes through aria-live; respect prefers-reduced-motion. The 6-dot grip must not be the only affordance, and the header button needs a visible focus ring (the concept defines none and relies on the browser default).

Keyboard. The concept has no Escape handler even though the tool is labelled 'Esc'. Escape must not fight the Modal and Drawer handlers in useOverlay. Selecting by header button plus context-bar tools far away in the left column creates a long tab distance: add 'skip to tools' or move focus to the toolbar on select. Tabs need aria-current; selected widgets need aria-pressed.

Wall and anonymity regressions. The concept's 'Export' on Active mappings and the Identity audit log would take identity ↔ token pairs off the console, contradicting 'Mappings never leave this console'. A raw audit export leaks user ↔ profile links (report.self_uploaded targets, coaching.generated employee ids). Candidate hints must stay on the mapping page only: never in KPIs, search, guide copy or the context-bar title. The research type-code, org and gender slices need n<5 suppression before export. The playground persona labels with real seeded names ('Dana · ISTJ captain') pair a real person with a type.

Naming drift that could push implementers into unsafe schema changes. Profile codes 'SKY-…' vs the enforced 'PROF-0000A-B' format; prompt families 'Flight briefing / Simulator / Training' vs briefing / debrief / coaching / normalize_report; categories 'Line pilot / Instructor / Cabin crew / Dispatcher' vs the DB enum; rule codes solo_brief / insight_read / consent_grant vs synergy_brief / weekly_insight_read / consent_given; audit codes prompt.activate / org.create / rule.update / user.invite / reward.publish vs the real codes; 'Add rule' and 'Add tier' vs the fixed tier enum and code-emitted actions. Treat the concept's data as sample, not spec.

Role and behaviour changes. Email invites replace the one-time temp-password model (needs SMTP and a set-password flow). The read-only rules and tiers widgets risk hiding the editing that exists today. Plain-text row actions (Unlink, Activate, Rollback) would drop the confirm dialogs for production-switching and access-revoking operations. Red is used for both primary actions (Link, Create) and destructive or alert states (Unlink, Unlinked count, Gold tier), so the meaning of colour becomes ambiguous; status also relies on dots, so pair them with text.

Phones. The concept's breakpoint CSS leaves c2, c6 and c8 unspanned at ≤1180 and ≤720, so widgets overflow into implicit columns. Tables (audit, rules, org table) and the 4-column link rows do not reflow. Six text tabs plus the utilities do not fit the bottom bar, and the ratio CSS already makes the tabs overlap at 1440. The context bar as a horizontal strip eats vertical space. The sticky bottom bar needs safe-area padding and canvas bottom padding. No phone design exists for this console: decide whether the super console is supported on phones or read-only there.

Performance. Overview already runs 7 queries plus an actor lookup. The layout reads, health probes (DB plus an auth listUsers) and per-widget loaders add latency, so stream each widget with Suspense and skip loaders for hidden widgets. Today the unlinked rows (with hints) are fetched twice per request just to count them. A cross-org mapping page needs candidate lists for every org (500 per org) and unpaged mapping and identity log functions. A client drag library adds bundle weight to an otherwise server-rendered console. Layout saves on every drag need debouncing and version checks for multi-tab conflicts.

CSP and assets. next.config.ts sets script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' (no CDN), font-src 'self' data:, img-src 'self' data: blob:, and connect-src 'self' plus the Supabase URL. Any drag, diff or palette library must be bundled from npm. The S3 brand SVG must be a local asset (public/ or inline). The concept's self-hosted Manrope maps to next/font (already self-hosted; it currently loads weights 400–800, latin only). The many inline styles from the prototype are allowed by style-src 'unsafe-inline' but should become tokens or classes so dark mode and hover work (inline backgrounds killed the concept's hover states).

Dark mode. The concept has no dark values while the app ships a working light/dark toggle. The navy/red/canvas palette needs dark tokens, or the console's 'Theme' button will produce unreadable navy-on-dark UI.

Persistence and authorisation. Layout jsonb comes from the client, so validate widget ids and spans against the registry server-side and cap the size. A stored hidden or pinned state must never gate data access. The new tables must follow the lockdown rule (explicit revoke from anon and authenticated, then minimal grants) and be covered by rls-check. Guide progress and layouts are per user, so a super admin switching to /admin or /app uses different surfaces.

Next.js 16 specifics. AGENTS.md warns that APIs and conventions differ: read node_modules/next/dist/docs (file conventions, intercepting and parallel routes, caching) before implementing drawers for full views, Suspense streaming or route handlers. Server actions keep their 1mb body limit (prompt content of 20000 chars fits).

Scope and consistency. The super board omits the guide, phone sheet and S/M/L/XL content definitions that other boards have, so super widgets need their own size variants authored (what S, M, L and XL show for each table and form). Empty, loading and error states are undesigned for every widget: reuse the current copy ('No audit events yet', 'All profiles in this organization are linked', 'No mappings yet', 'No organizations yet', 'No data for this slice', 'No events yet.').
